body.text: A small matter, and entirely yours to decide: the tea.
The colony cannot grow it and must buy it, at {param:amount} the season. The returns being {perception:purse}, I could tax it heavily and nobody would starve of it.
They would, of course, be extremely annoyed. That is rather the charm of the thing.

options.text: in no mood for small matters

options.label: tax the tea heavily
options.text: Tax it, and let them write to me about it.

options.label: leave the tea alone
options.text: Leave the tea alone. A colony with no small comforts is a colony with nothing to lose.
